messages:
sam (Docs): Quick thread: a partner called out inconsistent terminology in migration guides and asked for a concise example showing how phrasing should differ when describing Hosted vs Private. Can we align?
elaine (Product): Product rule: use 'Redwood' in feature blurbs; use 'we' in walkthroughs. Add a one-line convention to the style guide.
vijay (Eng): I'll produce a tiny SDK pseudo-snippet showing both plain_text and structured output so docs can show accessible output formatting.
noah (DevEx): I'll add a CI lint to catch Title Case vs sentence case for product modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). Keep the rule simple.
maria (Legal): Reminder: do not use absolute phrasing like "fully isolated". Use qualifiers: "designed to" or "intended to". I'll review glossary wording.
sam (Docs): Action items: (1) update docs/style/voice.md with the small rule and two example sentences (Hosted: "Redwood provides X"; Private guide: "We recommend configuring X"), (2) add SDK snippet under docs/examples/accessibility.md, (3) glossary sweep for private/dedicated/hosted phrasing. Volunteers: vijay for snippet, noah for lint, maria for legal review.
vijay (Eng): Snippet draft (pseudo): ```js
// return both a TTS-friendly string and structured bullets
const out = await redwood.generate({ model: 'rw-1-large', input: 'Summarize: list short bullets', format: 'json' });
console.log(out.plain_text); // TTS / screen reader
console.log(out.structured?.bullets || []); // keyboard nav
```
noah (DevEx): I'll land a small linter rule that flags uses of 'we' on product pages and Title Case misuse.
maria (Legal): I'll check the glossary PR after it's opened. Suggested glossary line for Private: "Private deployment — a deployment mode where networking is customer-managed; Redwood may provide an optional control plane component. Customers remain responsible for local compliance controls."
sam (Docs): Target: open PRs by Fri. Thanks all, please comment on the style guide draft when I post it. :thumbsup:
